response.sql:
WITH matched_executions AS (
  SELECT o.orderflow, e.fillcount
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN orderexecutions AS e
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
), status_counts AS (
  SELECT orderflow,
         AVG(fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity,
         COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM matched_executions
  GROUP BY orderflow
)
SELECT orderflow,
       average_filled_quantity,
       execution_count,
       execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_executions
FROM status_counts;

assumptions.assumption: Statuses with no matching executions are omitted; the request groups executions by status, and the denominator is the count of matched executions across statuses.
